title: How Signal Latency Shapes Trading Bot Profitability
meta_title: How Signal Latency Shapes Trading Bot Profitability
meta_description: Discover how signal latency affects your trading bot's edge, with real broker numbers and a step-by-step way to measure your own setup.
excerpt: A practical look at how signal latency actually affects trading-bot profitability, with real broker numbers and a measurement workflow you can run today.
key_takeaways_markdown:
- Latency only hurts retail bots above strategy-specific thresholds; not every millisecond matters.
- p99 latency (the worst 1% of trades) tells you more than p50 about real P&L impact.
- You can measure your full signal-to-fill latency in 10 minutes with tools already on your VPS.
